description: Code that inspects or changes how classes, attributes and modules are built and looked up, while the program runs.
Decorator, then `__init_subclass__`, then descriptors, then metaclasses: pick the lowest rung that solves the problem.
The class of a class. `type` by default; a subclass of `type` customizes how classes are prepared, created, initialized and called.
Resolve the metaclass, `__prepare__` the namespace, run the body, call the metaclass (`__set_name__`, then `__init_subclass__`), apply decorators, bind the name.
A finder on `sys.meta_path` that tells `import` where a module comes from and which loader runs it.
